html: † אַשִׁפָּה n.f. quiver for arrows (Assyrian išpatu DlK 29) א׳ lit. as part of warlike equipment Jb 39:23 Is 22:6 Je 5:16; fig. in sim. of sons of one’s youth as arrows (weapons which the father may wield) ψ 127:5 אַשְׁרֵי הַגֶּבֶר אֲשֶׁר מִלֵּא אֶת־אַשְׁפָּתוֹ מֵהֶם the happiness of the man that hath filled his quiver with them! of Yahweh’s quiver, in metaph. of prophet as arrow of י׳ Is 49:2 וַיְשִׂימֵנִי לְחֵץ בָּרוּר בְּאַשְׁפָּתוֹ הִסְתִּירָ֑נִי and he made me into a polished arrow, in his quiver he hid me; also of quiver in which י׳ has his arrows of chastisement, בְּנֵי,אַשְׁפָּתוֹ, i.e. his arrows La 3:13 (‖ חֵץ v 12).
